name: project-status
title: Project status and forecast
for_each: select id,code from projects order by code

sections.title: Budget review
sections.note: Forecast contribution is not recognised profit. All figures exclude tax and overhead.

sections.title: Open delivery work
sections.sql: select name,due_on,remaining_minutes from tasks where project_id=$1 and status='open' order by due_on

name: scope-approval
title: Draft scope change request
for_each: select id,reference from changes where status='pending' order by reference

sections.title: Requested change
sections.note: Not approved. Obtain written client agreement before recording approval.
sections.sql: select p.code,c.reference,c.description,c.fee,p.currency,c.minutes,c.requested_by from changes c join projects p on p.id=c.project_id where c.id=$1

name: billing-worksheet
title: Draft billing worksheet
for_each: select id,code from projects order by code

sections.title: Engagement basis
sections.note: Not a tax invoice. Reconcile with contract milestones or retainer terms in your accounting system.

sections.title: Approved unbilled effort
sections.note: Effort value does not establish an amount payable. Nothing marked billed.
sections.sql: select t.worked_on,n.name,t.description,t.minutes,t.sell_rate,round(t.minutes*t.sell_rate/60,2) effort_value from time_entries t join people n on n.id=t.person_id where t.project_id=$1 and t.billable and t.approved_by is not null and t.billed_ref is null order by t.worked_on,t.id

name: retainer-statement
title: Retainer usage statement
for_each: select id,code from projects where kind='retainer' order by code

sections.title: Period and usage
sections.sql: select code,start_on,due_on,budget_minutes,logged_minutes,greatest(0,logged_minutes-budget_minutes) overage_minutes from project_health where id=$1

sections.title: Recorded work
sections.sql: select worked_on,description,minutes,billable from time_entries where project_id=$1 order by worked_on,id
